name: context-intent
description: Authoritative desired directions with scoped slots, optional success criteria, and supersede lifecycle.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project direction explicit and durable.
interface.longDescription: Captures desired project directions as authoritative INTENT artifacts, recalls them by scope, and supersedes them through context-core approval and storage.
defaultPrompt: Use active language; keep machine fields English. Claim desired project direction only; decline other owner meanings.
Keep intent optional for decisions; connect them with serves:intent only when both artifacts exist.
Produce drafts and receipts only. Delegate every persistent write, lock, CAS, preview, and apply to context-core.
